name: environment-search-blind-spot-v1
method: Ten Estonian, misspelled and multi-intent queries selected during an isolated completion audit. Their cases and labels are locked as a post-fix regression set, not presented as an independently preregistered blind benchmark.

baselineClaim.reason: The historical evaluator aborts because well-register and marine-observations do not exist at that revision; a faithful manual score over the ten locked labels is 0.3. The claim is retained only as an explicitly invalidated audit record.
